_: scripts/lost-condition-check.mjs (npm run verify). Every predicated Foundry rule on a shipped record (CriticalSpecialization excluded: critspec-narrowing-check owns it) whose unconditional counterpart on our record carries a condition family nothing carries is an OVER-GRANT and fails — lit or dark — unless an entry here excuses that family. An entry names the record, the Foundry rule key, optionally the counterpart (`selector`, or `type` for Resistance/Weakness/Immunity), the `families` it excuses, a `verdict` (print-unconditional | route | default-state | needs-reading | kept-over-grant; needs-reading needs an open/deferred `ownerQuestion` and prints as a warning; kept-over-grant is a REAL over-grant kept ONLY while it waits on the owner's approval (the owner's rule, 2026-10-17: a known over-grant fails), needs `blockedBy.gate` (the dark star/mode that would replace the number, which must still be dark; `files` may only sit beside a gate, never alone) and `awaitsApproval` (the desk number whose approval in scripts/data/trust-approvals.json would light the gate, still pending there: #126 for the Ruling-B stars) and `followUp` and `trust` (dark | partly | lit: the trust state of its over-granting field when written; the live state must equal it, so a kept DARK over-grant that an approval lights fails), and prints as a warning on every run), and the printed clause (`quote`, found in `aonId` = the record's own Archives page) with a `why`. A listed family that no longer over-grants fails as STALE. `snapshot` is the measured predicated set, rewritten only by `jiti scripts/lost-condition-check.mjs --write-snapshot`. Created 2026-10-17 from the lost-condition measurement.

entries.quote: You permanently gain the effects of enlarge
entries.why: Foundry puts the enlarge effects behind a toggle; print makes them permanent after the one-time ceremony, so the standing sizeOverride is right.

entries.quote: your maximum Hit Points increase by your level
entries.why: Foundry puts the Hit Point increase behind the same toggle; print gives it permanently, so the standing maxHpBonus is right.

entries.quote: You permanently gain the effects of enlarge
entries.why: The toggle is not a condition (the enlarge effects are permanent). This excuses ONLY the toggle: the selector is melee-only (enlarge's damage bonus is to melee Strikes), so a strikeDamage entry that applies to every Strike still fails as a melee-only selector over-grant.

entries.quote: You constantly gain the effects of enlarge
entries.why: Print's default state is enlarged ("You can dismiss or resume these effects as an action"); Foundry's toggle is that dismiss switch, so the standing sizeOverride shows the default.

entries.quote: You gain thoughtsense as a vague sense that has a range of 30 feet
entries.why: Foundry's only Sense rule is the Unleash Psyche upgrade (imprecise); the standing sense on our record is print's unconditional VAGUE sense, and the imprecise upgrade is carried by whileActive unleash-psyche.

entries.quote: Your claws are agile, finesse unarmed attacks that deal 1d6 slashing damage and are in the brawling weapon group
entries.why: Foundry withholds the claw only while a draconic sorcerer's dragon claws spell is active (the spell's own claw supersedes it); print grants the claw attack with no condition.

entries.quote: start with their primary movement ability, choose the heritage that matches it most closely
entries.why: Not an over-grant: the check pairs our ancestry BASE land Speed 5 with Foundry's predicated BaseSpeed 20 ("not a swimming animal"). The ancestry page leaves Speed to the heritage: its mechanics block prints a Speed line with no value, and it has you pick the heritage by the animal's movement (the quote). Each heritage prints its own land Speed and ours carries it there: climbing-animal landSpeedMin 20 (heritage-288: "You have a land Speed of 20 feet, a climb Speed of 20 feet"), flying-animal 20 (heritage-289: "You have a land Speed of 20 feet"), running-animal 30 (heritage-290: "You have a land Speed of 30 feet"), and swimming-animal's water-dwelling option landSpeedMin 20 (heritage-291: "if you can move on land, you have base Speed of 20 feet"); an aquatic swimming animal keeps the base 5, as Foundry's base does. (Reconcile 2026-10-17, from work/lost-condition-verdicts.json; quote replaced in round 3, the old one was the mechanics block's header text.)

entries.quote: You gain the Specialty Crafting skill feat
entries.why: Foundry's predicate is its Season of Ghosts family/foundling background adjustment (background-variant), a variant our mirror prints nowhere; the page grants the skill feat outright. Backgrounds are chassis (always on) under the trust gate.

entries.quote: You gain the Oddity Identification skill feat
entries.why: The same Foundry background-variant predicate as Close Ties (printed nowhere in our mirror); the page grants the feat outright.

entries.quote: You gain resistance equal to 3 + half your level to force and sonic damage.
entries.why: Read on innovation-1 (the newest printing, R12; innovation-5 agrees): this resistance sentence (the quote) prints no wearing condition, and no INITIAL modification prints one. The page prints "While wearing your/the armor" modification by modification, not by tier: Antimagic Plating, Camouflage Pigmentation, Dense Plating, Layered Mesh, Tensile Absorption, Automated Impediments, Energy Barrier, Multisensory Mask and Physical Protections carry it (the five resistances among them carry defensesRequire {armored:true}), while Hyper Boosters, a breakthrough, prints none. Foundry's armor predicate is evidence, not a source; Wanderer's Guide is unconditional too. The Overdrive +2 is the separate state variant.

entries.quote: You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed, which increases to a +20-foot status bonus when you're in Overdrive.
entries.why: As Harmonic Oscillator: innovation-1 prints no wearing condition on Hyper Boosters (the page prints that clause modification by modification, and this breakthrough has none). Wanderer's Guide is unconditional too; the Overdrive increase is the record's whileActive overdrive state.

entries.quote: You gain resistance equal to 3 + half your level to acid and electricity damage.
entries.why: As Harmonic Oscillator: an initial modification, printed with no wearing condition on innovation-1. The Overdrive +2 is the record's whileActive overdrive state.

entries.quote: You gain resistance equal to 3 + half your level to void damage, or to vitality damage if you have void healing
entries.why: As Harmonic Oscillator: an initial modification, printed with no wearing condition on innovation-1. Covers all five counterparts (void, vitality, spirit, holy, unholy) for the armor family only; the void/vitality swap and the holy/unholy sanctification split are carried by whenVoidHealing / whenCreatureTrait.

entries.quote: Additionally, you gain resistance 2 + half your level against precision damage.
entries.why: The only "while wearing the armor" on this entry scopes the sentence before it ("Each time you're critically hit while wearing the armor, attempt a DC 13 flat check"); the resistance sentence prints none, and innovation-1 writes "While wearing your armor" in front of every other modification it means it for. Read as printed, not widened. Wanderer's Guide is unconditional too.

entries.quote: You gain resistance equal to half your level to cold and fire damage.
entries.why: As Harmonic Oscillator: an initial modification, printed with no wearing condition on innovation-1.

entries.quote: You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, which increases to a +10-foot status bonus when under the effects of Overdrive.
entries.why: As Harmonic Oscillator: an initial modification, printed with no wearing condition on innovation-1. The Overdrive increase is the record's whileActive overdrive state.

entries.quote: You gain a tail unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling group, and has the sweep trait.
entries.why: The only condition is "not under Shed Tail": Shed Tail (feat-5641) is a reaction the player takes deliberately ("Until it does, you can't use your tail unarmed attack"), so the default state has the tail (Principle P: the player knows they did the thing).

entries.quote: While you possess your head gem, you gain resistance 2 to piercing damage and resistance 1 to slashing damage.
entries.why: Every sarangay has a head gem from birth (ancestry-89: "From birth, every sarangay has a giant gleaming stone upon their brow known as their head gem"), and it can't be removed unless you're killed or permanently incapacitated first, so the default state possesses it. Covers both counterparts (piercing, slashing). Wanderer's Guide agrees (unconditional).

entries.quote: A beastkin's hybrid form is their natural shape.
entries.why: The beastkin's Change Shape (action-700) prints that most beastkin remain in their hybrid shapes by default and that the hybrid shape gives the jaws, so the standing Jaws is the default state; humanoid shape is the player's deliberate action. Dark under the trust gate.

snapshot._: The measured predicated set (scripts/lost-condition-check.mjs): one row per predicated Foundry rule on a shipped record — r = our record key, k = the Foundry rule key, s = the counterpart signature, a = the predicate atoms as families (f) with flags (n negated, o in an or-group, c/v a comparison, x an owned-record atom, own = names the record itself, st a class-resource state, ag agile), sib = an unpredicated sibling with the same effect, sk = skills a sibling explains, ab = traits every branch adds, bs = a state variant beside a base rule, sc = a selector that narrows to one kind of Strike, idem = "unless you already have it". No Foundry text. Rewritten only by `jiti scripts/lost-condition-check.mjs --write-snapshot` with the packs present.
